verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents a self-serve dashboard opt-out of its model improvement program, which stops customer audio being used for training; the community privacy concern in comm-5 is about exactly that training use. This is a data-use opt-out, not a documented switch for telemetry or usage tracking (SDK telemetry, analytics) as such, so it only partly matches the story. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out (e.g., SDK telemetry disable), documentation of what usage data is collected, independent corroboration that the opt-out works.
